title: E-Commerce Management Services (2026): How to Hire a Store Manager
description: E-commerce management services explained: hiring someone to run your online store or marketplace account, listings, orders, inventory, price drivers and red flags.
intro: E-commerce managers handle the daily running of online stores and marketplace accounts: product listings, pricing updates, inventory, orders, returns, promotions and reports. A good manager keeps the store accurate and running smoothly so you can focus on products and growth. Projects go wrong when access is too broad, tasks and limits are unclear, or nobody checks the numbers. This guide helps you hire a reliable store manager.
